basic_details.job_title: IIT Guwahati Assistant Project Scientist Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The School of Agro and Rural Technology at the Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati has invited online applications for one Assistant Project Scientist post in the project "Soil Fertility Assessment Using Soil Organic Carbon Detection Kit: Capacity Building and Implementation in Assam, North-East India". The total pay is Rs. 23000 for 3 months, with no HRA or medical. The essential qualification is a Postgraduate degree in Science/Humanities, or a Bachelor's degree in Science/Humanities with a minimum of 55% marks plus 4 years' experience. Apply on the IIT Guwahati Recruitment Portal by 30

how_to_apply: Visit the Recruitment Portal of Research & Development Cell, IIT Guwahati (https://iitg.ac.in/rndproj/recruitment/).
Follow the instructions and guidelines given on the portal.
Find the position by searching for the project title as printed in the advertisement.
Submit the application before 30 November 2026, 5.00 PM.
For technical help with the online application, write to [email protected]. For other clarification, contact Prof Sudip Mitra (Principal Investigator) at [email protected] or on 03612583800.

content_sections.heading: About the Project
content_sections.text: The notice comes from the Research and Development Section of IIT Guwahati, Guwahati-781039, Assam. The post is in a project titled "Soil Fertility Assessment Using Soil Organic Carbon Detection Kit: Capacity Building and Implementation in Assam, North-East India", based at the School of Agro and Rural Technology. The notice does not name a funding agency.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice lists one post, Assistant Project Scientist, with 01 vacancy. Previous experience of working with farmers and rural communities. Familiarity with field data collection, documentation and stakeholder interaction. Knowledge of local languages of Northeast India will be preferred. Prior experience in report writing, data analysis and data presentation. Willingness to travel extensively across Northeast India for fieldwork. The 55% marks condition and the 4 years' experience belong to the Bachelor's degree route, as the notice prints them. For the full eligibility, see the official notification.

rows.essential_qualification: Postgraduate degree in Science/Humanities OR Bachelor's degree in Science/Humanities (with a minimum of 55% marks) + 4 yrs. exp.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Guwahati Assistant Project Scientist
content_sections.text: For technical help with the online application, write to [email protected] . For other clarification, contact Prof Sudip Mitra (Principal Investigator) at [email protected] or on 03612583800.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice invites applications for an online interview, held on 1 December 2026 at 3.00 PM. Only shortlisted candidates will be intimated by email for the interview. The notice does not describe the shortlisting method.
